entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: The uprising in Ghirapur following the Inventors' Fair, led by renegades against the Consulate.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The Avishkari city thrown into turmoil.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane on which Ghirapur lies.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The government that imposes martial law and is weakened by defections.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: The inventors and freedom fighters who rise against the Consulate.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Planeswalkers who ally with the rebels to stop Tezzeret.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker building a Planar Bridge in the Aether Spire for his master.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An inventor whose space-folding device Tezzeret remakes into a Planar Bridge, and who is rescued by Liliana and Saheeli.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who rescues Rashmi and attacks Tezzeret.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An inventor who helps rescue Rashmi.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A Renegade leader focused on reforming the government.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker whose anger at Baral costs the rebels the Aether Hub.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who protects Chandra from her own blast.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who adds illusory airships.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch and advises on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: A Consulate officer who killed Chandra's father and baits her, and is later arrested.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Consulate figure who stows away and disables the aether disruptor, then disappears.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon deduced to be pulling Tezzeret's strings.

entities.name: Aether Hub
entities.description: The facility controlling the city's aether flow, taken over by the renegades.

entities.name: Aether Spire
entities.description: The spire where Tezzeret builds the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: Tezzeret's device for sending inanimate objects through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Heart of Kiran
entities.description: The renegade airship used in the assault on the Spire.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Bolas's plots unfold.

events.summary: The Grand Exhibition at the Inventors' Fair ends in stolen inventions, abducted inventors and violence, fracturing the Consulate and citizens and sparking revolt.
events.quote: inventions were stolen, inventors abducted, and violence threatened the crowds at the arena

events.summary: The Consulate imposes martial law with automaton soldiers and a secret police, but defections grow.
events.quote: The Consulate saw no other option than to instate a state of martial law in Ghirapur

events.summary: The Renegades swell in number and arm themselves with quicksmith armor, plated airships and raided aether.
events.quote: the Renegades saw their ranks swelling in the wake of the Inventors' Fair

events.summary: The Gatewatch plans with renegades to take over the Aether Hub to fuel an airship and hinder Tezzeret.
events.quote: They started planning a takeover of the hub

events.summary: Liliana and Saheeli rescue Rashmi from Tezzeret, and the Gatewatch learns his plan and takes the Aether Hub.
events.quote: Liliana Vess and Saheeli Rai came to the rescue of Rashmi, freeing her from Tezzeret's clutches

events.summary: Baral baits Chandra into leaving the hub, enabling a Consulate counterattack that retakes it.
events.quote: their absence left the hub open for a Consulate counterattack

events.summary: The renegades attack the Aether Spire in three teams, but Dovin Baan disables the disruptor and Baral dispels Jace's illusions; Pia's gremlins disable the cannon.
events.quote: Dovin Baan had secretly stowed away aboard the Heart of Kiran and managed to disable the aether disruptor

events.summary: Chandra destroys the Planar Bridge with a fireblast shielded by Gideon, and Tezzeret inserts its core into himself and planeswalks away.
events.quote: grabbed the core piece of the Planar Bridge, inserting it into his midsection, and then planeswalking away to his mysterious master

events.summary: The revolt turns to reform; martial law ends, Baral is arrested, and Ajani joins the Gatewatch, who deduce Bolas is behind Tezzeret.
Chandra says a tearful farewell to her mother and home.
events.quote: Chandra said a tearful farewell to her mother and home

relations.quote: The Gatewatch allied with the rebels

relations.note: killed her father and baited her
relations.quote: Baral , who had killed her father and almost done the same to her

relations.note: held her captive for his Planar Bridge
relations.quote: she found his manner to be arrogant, rude, condescending, and malicious
it must be Nicol Bolas pulling the artificer's strings
the renegades led by Pia saw an opportunity for reform
managed to disable the aether disruptor
